title: Senior Business Continuity Analyst (BCM)
description:
Purpose of the Position

An Asian financial institution, recognized as one of the largest and among the leading banks worldwide, with a strong presence across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. In Brazil, the institution focuses on corporate and investment banking, providing clients with tailored financial solutions.


With a global reputation for stability and long-term relationships, the institution continues to invest in innovation, cybersecurity, and sustainability, reinforcing its commitment to responsible growth and the protection of client interests in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.


The main idea of this role is to protect the institution’s ability to deliver critical banking services during disruption by owning and advancing the BCM – Business Continuity Management program processes. This is a hands-on, orchestration-heavy position that translates global continuity standards into effective local execution and audit-ready evidence.

Concretely, the role:

  • Leads the BCM lifecycle end-to-end: conducts BIAs (criticality, dependencies, RTO/RPO), maintains BCPs, and plans/coordinates tests (e.g., DR/switch-over validations, contingency site, VDI/endpoint readiness, evacuation drills, call tree), including out-of-hours windows.
  • Turns results into decisions: surfaces risks, residual exposures, and disclaimers to risk committees; drives lessons learned and closes open issues with robust documentation and owners/dates/evidence.
  • Connects BCM to the broader non-financial risk picture: interfaces with Operational Incidents, Vendor Risk, Products & Services, and RCSA so that continuity risks and control gaps are consistently identified, tracked, and remediated.
  • Bridges global and local: adapts global policy/standards to Brazil’s context, ensuring regulatory fit (BACEN) without diluting control integrity.
  • Influences without formal authority: engages senior stakeholders (e.g., Treasury and Operations leaders) to prioritize continuity activities, align on test windows, and validate outcomes; partners with IT/IS to validate DR without performing technical changes.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Operate the existing Business Continuity framework while continuously improving its maturity, expanding coverage, and strengthening evidence quality.
  • Organize and document activities using spreadsheets and manual controls, ensuring that all records are audit-ready and compliant with internal and external requirements.
  • Plan, coordinate, and lead continuity tests, including out-of-hours exercises, anticipating risks, resolving issues on the spot, and making sound, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Adapt global policies and methodologies to the Brazilian regulatory context, maintaining alignment with global standards and full compliance with BACEN requirements.
  • Engage and influence critical business areas, such as Treasury and Operations, to secure collaboration and prioritization of BCM activities without direct authority.
  • Map critical processes, conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIA), and maintain updated Business Continuity Plans (BCP).
  • Develop, update, and review continuity policies, standards, and procedures, while supporting the management of open issues, regulatory requirements, and action plans.
  • Deliver training to teams and managers on continuity and disaster recovery procedures, proactively monitor external events and news for potential risks
  • This role will also involve executing other operational risk programs such as Operational Incident Management, Vendor/Product & Service Risk Management, etc.


Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Bring solid experience gained over several years in financial institutions, with a proven track record in Business Continuity Management, including BIA, BCP, and continuity testing.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of operational resilience practices, with exposure to RCSA, operational incident management, and vendor/third-party risk.
  • Be comfortable coordinating with IT and Information Security (IS) teams during disaster recovery validations, leading and validating outcomes without performing the technical execution.
  • Possess proficiency in Excel for data analysis and tracking, and PowerPoint for building clear, executive-level presentations and reports.
  • Communicate effectively in English at a level to interact with global stakeholders and follow corporate standards.
  • Hold a degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems/Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Bank Policies and Regulations, familiarity with cyber risk policies, procedures, and regulations, and the ability to review and ensure compliance with these requirements (Differential). Bring additional exposure to ISO 22301 standards, experience with tools such as Visio or Power BI/Power Query, and professional certifications in business continuity or disaster recovery (e.g., CBCP, DRII, BRCCI). (Differential)


Behavioral Skills

  • Executive communication & influence – Engages effectively with senior stakeholders, articulates complex topics in a clear, concise manner, and secures alignment in risk committees.
  • Proactivity & ownership – Demonstrates a self-starter mindset, acting hands-on and taking full responsibility for driving initiatives to completion.
  • Organization, discipline & critical thinking – Maintains audit-ready documentation with rigor and structure, while applying analytical thinking and sound judgment to make timely, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Collaboration & resilience – Partners seamlessly with Non-Tech areas and IT/IS, showing adaptability and composure under pressure, and adjusting course when unexpected challenges arise.


SE#

title: Especialista de Segurança da Informação I (Cyber Threat Intelligence)
description:

Tá a fim de uma carreira que rende mais? Confira essa oportunidade e #VemProPags!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Coleção e análise de inteligência: OSINT/HUMINT, monitoramento de deep/dark web, fóruns e marketplaces de threat actors, identificação de leaks (dados, credenciais, cartões, kits de phishing, malwares).
  • Brand e Executive Protection: proteção de marca, domínio e executivos (typosquatting, spoofing, influencer/clone, perfis falsos, phishing kits).
  • Produção de inteligência acionável: elaboração de PIRs (Priority Intelligence Requirements), criação de Collection Plans, relatórios estratégicos/táticos/operacionais, briefings executivos e TL, DR para tomada de decisão.
  • Análise de TTPs: mapeamento em MITRE ATT&CK, ATT&CK Navigator, criação de detections (Sigma/YARA) e hipóteses para Threat Hunting.
  • Purple Teaming: condução de Purple Exercises com Red/Blue, validação contínua de controles (BAS como Cymulate/Similares), hardening de AD (Tiering, LAPS, Kerberos, Delegações, GPOs), uso de Purple Knight/BloodHound para identificar caminhos de ataque.
  • Integração com SOC/CSIRT: criação e tuning de regras no SIEM/SOAR, priorização de alertas, enriquecimento de IOCs/IOAs, suporte a investigações e resposta a incidentes.
  • Gestão de IOCs/MISP/TIPs: curadoria, scoring, deduplicação, enriquecimento e automação de feeds/provedores, governança de taxonomias (ex.: MISP Galaxy/Clusters).
  • Ameaças ao financeiro: acompanhamento de Threat Landscape (fraudes, mule accounts, trojans bancários, ransomware-as-a-service, initial access brokers, engenharia social, QRishing, MFA bypass, SIM swap, Pix/instant payments).
  • Conformidade & risco: apoio a políticas e padrões (NIST/ISO/CIS), evidências para auditorias e reporte a comitês de risco.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo ou em cursando em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Software, Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com CTI (estratégico/tático/operacional) com atuação prática em deep/dark web e análise de comunidades de ameaças.
  • Vivência em Purple/Red/Blue realizando participação em pentests/red teaming e/ou BAS, habilidade de traduzir inteligência em controles e deteções.
  • Domínio em MITRE ATT&CK, MISP/TIPs, técnicas de OSINT e HUMINT, criação de YARA/Sigma, noções de malware analysis e forense (memória/endpoint).
  • Experiência com validação de controles de segurança (EDR/XDR, E-mail Gateway, WAF, DLP, ZTNA/Proxy, Cloud, EASM/ASM) e hardening de AD.
  • Conhecimento em Threat Landscape Financeiro.
  • Inglês técnico para leitura/redação.
  • Disponibilidade para participar de exercícios com Red/Blue e on-call pontual durante incidentes críticos.


Informações adicionais

Para se destacar nesta posição seria legal se você também tivesse :

  • Experiência com Cymulate (ou BAS similar), Purple Knight, BloodHound/Sharphound, ATT&CK Navigator.
  • Automação com Python (enriquecimento, parsing de IOCs, integração com APIs de TIP/SIEM/SOAR).
  • Certificações: GCTI, GOSI, GREM, GPEN, OSINT, CFR, eJPT/eCPPT, CARTP/CRTP/CRTE, Azure/M365 Security.

Ferramentas e stack desejadas:

  • TIP/Intel: MISP, OpenCTI/TIPs comerciais, VirusTotal/Hybrid, Shodan/Censys, Maltego.
  • Detecção/Resposta: SIEM (Splunk/QRadar/Elastic), SOAR, EDR/XDR (Defender, Vision One, CarbonBlack, CrowdStrike, etc.).
  • Purple/BAS & AD: Cymulate/AttackIQ, Purple Knight, BloodHound.
  • Hunting/Detections: Sigma, YARA, KQL/ESQL, Zeek/Suricata; ATT&CK Navigator.
  • Brand/Dark: plataformas de brand monitoring, dark web monitoring e takedown.

Indicadores desejáveis:

  • TTI (Time-to-Intel) e Actionability dos reports; taxa de PIRs atendidos.
  • Cobertura de TTPs (ATT&CK) e detections derivadas de inteligência.
  • Redução de janela de exposição (tempo de takedown/containment) e de falsos positivos.
  • Validação contínua de controles (BAS) e fechamento de gaps críticos (AD/endpoint/email/web).

title: Product Owner
description:

Aqui, seu potencial só será limitado pelo tamanho dos seus sonhos. Produto e Projetos na Hypesoft


Nosso time de Produto e Projetos atua na interseção entre negócios, tecnologia e experiência do usuário. Trabalhamos lado a lado com as equipes de Engenharia, Design e Dados para transformar ideias em soluções digitais de alto impacto. Buscamos profissionais com visão sistêmica, curiosidade intelectual e paixão por entregar valor real aos clientes.


O que você fará


Como Product Owner / Analista de Projetos , você será responsável por conectar necessidades de negócio à execução técnica, garantindo clareza, priorização e entrega de valor. Participará desde a concepção de novas soluções até o acompanhamento do desenvolvimento e validação com stakeholders internos e externos.


Você atuará de forma próxima às squads, ajudando a traduzir estratégias em histórias de usuário, validando hipóteses e assegurando que cada entrega contribua para os objetivos de produto e negócio.

  • Levantar, entender e documentar requisitos de negócio e técnicos junto aos stakeholders.

  • Elaborar cronogramas, planos de entrega e relatórios de acompanhamento de projetos.
  • Analisar métricas de produto e propor melhorias contínuas baseadas em dados e feedbacks.
  • Garantir a comunicação eficiente entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.


Requisitos



  • Pelo menos 1 ano de experiência (profissional ou acadêmica) em gestão de projetos, produto ou análise de requisitos .
  • Conhecimento prático de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) .
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em especificações funcionais.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Trello, Notion, ClickUp ou similares).
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em clareza e colaboração.
  • Noções de ciclo de vida de software e integração entre times técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação.


Diferenciais



  • Experiência em ambientes de consultoria ou software house.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de prototipação (Figma, Miro, etc.).
  • Vivência com métricas de produto (OKRs, KPIs, NPS, etc.).
  • Noções de automação de processos (n8n, Make, Zapier, etc.) ou IA generativa aplicada a gestão de produtos.
  • Certificações em metodologias ágeis (PSPO, CSM, PMI-ACP, etc.).
  • Uso de n8n ou outras plataformas de automação de fluxos.
  • Experimentos com Gen AI (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) em projetos pessoais ou profissionais.


Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia e quer crescer em um ambiente que valoriza autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e impacto real, a Hypesoft é o lugar certo para você. Candidate‑se e venha construir o futuro conosco!

Criar e implementar soluções inovadoras para otimizar os sistemas de dados, utilizando tecnologias emergentes, como machine learning, data lake, streaming de dados em tempo real e big data analytics.

Comunicar soluções técnicas de forma clara e concisa para stakeholders, gestores, desenvolvedores e outras áreas, influenciando decisões estratégicas e contribuindo para o alinhamento da estratégia de dados com os objetivos da empresa.

Domínio profundo de linguagens de programação Python, além de ferramentas de processamento de dados como Apache Spark, Kafka, Flink ou equivalentes.

Conhecimento em LLMs, ajuste fino de modelos de IA e uso de RAG para melhorar eficiência na busca e recuperação de informações. Domínio dos serviços do Amazon Bedrock e/ou Azure OpenAI.

Experiência com arquitetura de sistemas de dados, big data (Hadoop, Hive, HBase), streaming (Kafka, Kinesis) e bancos de dados (SQL, NoSQL).

Conhecimento avançado de ferramentas de modelagem de dados, processamento de dados e visualização de dados, como SQL, NoSQL, Tableau, Power BI, etc.

Conhecimento avançado em construção de Data Lake e Data Warehouse usando ferramentas como AWS Athena, AWS Redshift, AWS S3, AWS Glue, Airbyte, DBT e Postgres.

Compreensão profunda de conceitos de machine learning e aplicacão de técnicas de machine learning em sistemas de dados.

Habilidades de comunicação clara e eficaz, tanto verbal como escrita, para se comunicar com diferentes públicos (técnicos e não técnicos).

title: Senior Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.


What You'll Do


  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets;
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta;
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry;
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience;
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.


What We Need From You


  • Over 8 years of experience in key account management, channel development, or retail management, with a solid foundation in management methodologies and practices.
  • Strong business negotiation and market expansion skills, with a keen ability to identify client and user needs and a proactive attitude toward challenges.
  • Experienced in process and project management, with the ability to drive multiple tasks and projects concurrently.
  • Highly reliable and resilient, demonstrating strong work enthusiasm and a collaborative team spirit.
  • Fluent in English (speaking, reading, and writing) and capable of using it as a working language; proficiency in Portuguese is a strong plus.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Diretor de Saúde e Segurança – Operações da América do Sul/Director, Health & Safety – South American Operations
description:
O Diretor Regional de Saúde e Segurança (Operações da América do Sul) é responsável por liderar e supervisionar a função de saúde e segurança em todos as operações e projetos na América do Sul. Essa função garante a implementação efetiva da estratégia corporativa de saúde e segurança, impulsiona a melhoria contínua e promove uma cultura de segurança proativa alinhada com o compromisso da Pan American Silver em fazer "Segurança de forma Diferente ". O Diretor Regional trabalha em estreita colaboração com a liderança do local, as equipes corporativas de saúde e segurança e as equipes de projeto para prevenir ferimentos graves e fatalidades, garantir a conformidade regulatória e promover as melhores práticas.


Linha de relatório

  • Reporta-se a: Vice-Presidente de Saúde e Segurança
  • Localização: Residência na América do Sul necessária.
  • Viagens: 30-40% anualmente para locais de operação e desenvolvimento, muitas vezes em grandes altitudes ou regiões remotas da América do Sul
  • Reporte: Líderes de Saúde e Segurança das Operações/Projetos (Pontilhado/Matricial)


Principais responsabilidades

  • Implementar e supervisionar a estratégia corporativa de saúde e segurança em todos os sites da América do Sul, com foco no gerenciamento de riscos críticos e prevenção de lesões graves e fatalidades: SIF (CRM, FIT/HOP, etc.)
  • Atuar como o principal elo de ligação entre a liderança das operações/projetos e o departamento corporativo de saúde e segurança.
  • Liderar, treinar e desenvolver equipes de saúde e segurança no local, garantindo a execução eficaz de programas de gerenciamento de segurança e planos de ação
  • Colaborar com a liderança do local e do projeto para identificar, planejar e executar projetos de melhoria técnica e metas anuais de saúde e segurança
  • Garantir que planos robustos de resposta a emergências e sistemas de preparação estejam em vigor e sejam testados regularmente
  • Monitorar o cumprimento da legislação, diretrizes e políticas de saúde e segurança da empresa; comunicar atualizações e garantir a implementação de novos requisitos
  • Incentivar a comunicação e o compartilhamento de lições aprendidas com incidentes e eventos de alto potencial em todos os locais
  • Promover uma cultura de segurança como um valor fundamental, envolvendo as partes interessadas em todos os níveis e servindo como um líder visível na região.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e a resposta à gestão de crises em nível regional
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios, métricas e recomendações de desempenho de segurança para líderes regionais e corporativos, incluindo relatórios mensais e trimestrais


Habilidades e experiência necessárias

  • 10+ anos de experiência em cargos de liderança em saúde e segurança na indústria de mineração, incluindo operações de sites na América Latina
  • Experiência comprovada na implementação de sistemas de gestão de segurança e garantia da conformidade com os padrões internacionais e locais de saúde e segurança

  • Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas, gerenciamento de projetos e organização
  • Bacharelado em Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho, Engenharia ou disciplina relacionada (Segurança Industrial, Ciências Ambientais, Engenharia de Minas, Geociências, Ciências Sociais)
  • É preferível um mestrado ou qualificação de pós-graduação relevante
  • É necessária fluência em espanhol e inglês, é desejável proficiência em português


Competências-chave

  • Experiência em ambientes multiculturais; É necessária experiência atual ou anterior de trabalho em países da América Latina
  • Proficiência na criação de materiais atraentes para partes interessadas internas e externas
  • Liderança inspiradora e capacidade de motivar equipes multifuncionais
  • Mentalidade estratégica focada na melhoria contínua e excelência operacional
  • Habilidades eficazes de comunicação e apresentação, capazes de interagir com as equipes do local e a alta administração
  • Capacidade de traduzir questões gerais de segurança em planos regionais acionáveis


Outros requisitos

  • Deverá residir na América do Sul

The Director, Health & Safety – South American Operations is responsible for leading and overseeing the health and safety function across all mining sites and projects in our South American Operations region. This role ensures the effective implementation of corporate health and safety strategy, drives continuous improvement, and fosters a proactive safety culture aligned with Pan American Silver’s commitment to “Doing Safety Differently”. The Director collaborates closely with site leadership, Corporate health and safety (H&S), and project teams to prevent serious injuries and fatalities - SIFs, ensure regulatory compliance, and promote best practices.


Reports to: Vice President, Health & Safety.

Location: Residence in South America is required.

Travel: 30–40% annually to operating and development sites, often at high altitudes or remote regions in South America.

Direct Reports: Site Health and Safety Leaders (dotted line/matrix org.).


Major Responsibilities:

  • Implement and oversee the corporate health and safety strategy at all South American Operations sites, focusing on critical risk management and prevention of serious injuries and fatalities – SIFs (CRM, FIT/HOP, etc.).
  • Act as the primary liaison between site leadership and Corporate H&S.
  • Lead, coach, and develop site H&S teams, ensuring effective execution of safety management programs and action plans.
  • Collaborate with site and project leadership to identify, plan, and execute technical improvement projects and annual H&S objectives.
  • Ensure robust emergency response plans and preparedness systems are in place and regularly tested.
  • Monitor compliance with health and safety legislation, guidelines, and company policies; communicate updates and ensure implementation of new requirements.
  • Foster communication and sharing of lessons learned from incidents and high-potential events across sites.
  • Promote a culture of safety as a core value, engaging stakeholders at all levels and serving as a visible leader in the region.
  • Support crisis management planning and response at the regional level.
  • Prepare and present safety performance reports, metrics, and recommendations to regional and corporate leadership, including monthly and quarterly reports.


Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in health and safety leadership roles within the mining industry, including site operations in South America.
  • Proven experience implementing Safety Management Systems and ensuring compliance with international and local health and safety regulations.
  • Advanced expertise in risk analysis, incident investigation (e.g., ICAM) and implementation of Critical Control Management (e.g., FRM, CRM, etc.).
  • Strong problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related discipline (e.g., Industrial Safety, Environmental Science, Mining Engineering, Geoscience, Social Science).
  • Master’s Degree or relevant postgraduate education is preferred.
  • Fluency in Spanish and English required, Portuguese proficiency is an asset.


Key Competencies

  • Experience in multicultural environments; current or previous experience working in Latin American countries is required.
  • Proficiency in creating compelling materials for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Inspirational leadership and ability to motivate cross-functional teams.
  • Strategic mindset focused on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills, able to engage with site teams and senior management.
  • Ability to translate broad safety themes into actionable regional plans.


Other Requirements

  • Willingness and ability to travel to operations and development sites, often at high altitudes and/or in remote regions of South America.
  • Must reside in South America.

title: Pessoa Analista Financeiro Pleno
description:
Sobre a vaga


A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO


O cargo de Analista II Financeiro é garantir a precisão, integridade e conformidade das informações financeiras da empresa, apoiando a tomada de decisão estratégica por meio de análises detalhadas, controles eficazes e gestão eficiente dos recursos financeiros.

  • Controlar e acompanhar os índices de inadimplência, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Fornecer informações e documentos relacionados às contas a receber, assegurando transparência e conformidade durante auditorias
  • Colaborar com outras áreas, compartilhando informações de recebíveis para facilitar a tomada de decisão.


O QUE PRECISA


  • Capacidade de criar e interpretar planilhas, relatórios e gráficos analíticos.
  • Habilidade de interpretar dados financeiros e propor soluções baseadas em resultados.
  • Garantir precisão e consistência nos registros e relatórios de contas a receber.
  • Gerenciar prazos, demandas e prioridades de maneira eficiente.

title: Dealer Development Specialist
description:
We are hiring for one of our clients a leading manufacturer of bikes, Qutes ＆ electric 3-wheeler


Job Title: Dealer Development Manager

Base Location: Sao Paulo


Experience Requirement : 5 years of relevant experience in Dealer Development, Network Expansion, and Automotive Retail Operations with exposure to dealer audits, process improvement, and profitability management.


Role Type: Individual Contributor


Role Purpose: To drive dealer network effectiveness, profitability, and readiness by ensuring process excellence, systems standardization, and continuous capability enhancement across all dealerships. The role will be pivotal in shaping the of dealer network, ensuring strong process discipline and sustainable business growth.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Dealer Network Development & Performance

· Drive network planning and coverage expansion, ensuring strategic presence across markets to maximize business potential.

· Design and implement workshops aligned with corporate identity (CI) norms, optimizing dealer infrastructure and service readiness.

· Conduct periodic dealer performance reviews to assess business health, profitability, and customer experience outcomes.

· Identify underperforming dealerships, recommend improvement plans, and oversee implementation through cross-functional collaboration.

· Strengthen dealer capability through structured engagement, capability-building, and performance enhancement programs.

· Partner with field teams to ensure uniform brand experience across all customer touchpoints such as sales and aftersales.

2. Systems, Processes & Operational Excellence

· Establish and standardize systems, processes, and review mechanisms across all dealerships and regions to ensure consistent operations and governance.

· Implement and monitor business analytics and intelligence tools to enable data-driven decision-making and profitability tracking at dealerships.

· Lead process improvement and re-engineering initiatives to enhance efficiency, responsiveness, and dealer–customer experience.

· Identify and replicate Good Working Practices (GWPs) from within the automotive industry to drive continuous improvement.

· Audit dealerships to assess adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and recommend corrective actions to sustain performance and compliance.

· Ensure organizational and dealer readiness for new or updated systems, digital tools, and operational frameworks.


Key Interfaces:

Internal Stakeholders:

· Field Sales Teams

· Service Teams

· Finance

· Legal

External Stakeholders:

· Dealership Owners and Management Teams


Impact & Contribution:

· Direct impact on dealer profitability, customer experience, and market performance.

· Strengthens network capability by ensuring standardized processes, operational efficiency, and strategic coverage.

· Acts as a key enabler in transforming the dealer ecosystem into a digitally capable, performance-driven, and customer-centric network.

  • Knowledge Leadership: Contribute to the overall organizational knowledge base and foster active knowledge sharing across the global HR community.

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 4+ years in a senior HR Business Partnering or strategic advisory role spanning multiple LATAM countries .

  • Flexibility: Willingness to accommodate business needs across different time zones (LATAM and North America).

title: FBS Sr Product Designer
description:
Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.


About the Role

Farmers hiring a Senior User Experience (UX) Designer to join the Farmers Customer Experience Team, a multidisciplinary group that combines the power of human-centered and data-driven approaches to create end-to-end omni-channel experiences that enhance customer satisfaction, streamline operations, and deliver business impact.

This role drives strategic design by deeply understanding current user experiences, identifying opportunities, and envisioning future-state solutions. It leads the creation of effective user experiences through advanced UX principles and strategic thinking while independently delivering design solutions, collaborating with stakeholders, and contributing to evolving design systems.

The ideal candidate would have already achieved a senior level of UX and digital product design proficiency (including the associated tools, collaboration skills, and understanding of technology) and is now looking to grow by applying that experience strategically within the broader context of Customer Experience and Service Design.


Key Responsabilities


  • Plans and facilitates workshops and design sprints to establish alignment, understand business objectives, develop concepts, and chart strategic paths forward.
  • Contributes to user research efforts interviews, surveys, usability testing, A/B tests, and competitive evaluations to uncover behaviors, motivations, and pain points. Collaborates with Journey Owners and research teams to define target audiences and goals.
  • Maps user journeys, workflows, and service touchpoints to identify pain points and opportunities.
  • Applies insights to recommend UX improvements, validate decisions, and develop design concepts that balance user needs with business objectives.
  • Creates wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs to explore, communicate, and document solutions.
  • Tests and refines layouts, user interfaces, interaction patterns, and system components to ensure consistency and quality. Develops clear documentation and specifications to enable seamless implementation and guide development processes. Supports the evolution of design systems by evaluating and updating components to promote scalability and reusability.
  • Collaborates with product teams, development teams, and stakeholders to define requirements and co-create solutions. Participates in planning sessions and design reviews to facilitate implementation of features and functionality as designed.
  • Keeps stakeholders informed on goals, expectations, and timelines throughout the design process. Leads meetings effectively and presents with polish, using advanced storytelling and presentation skills to convey context, design concepts and rationale through a compelling narrative.
  • Conducts post-launch design evaluations to assess effectiveness of the design work, identify usability issues, recommend refinements, and measure impact.
  • Accepts and incorporates feedback to improve performance and work quality while knowing when to change direction or stay the course.
  • Seeks out opportunities to advance design skills by staying informed on trends, tools, and best practices in user experience. Actively explores and appropriately integrates AI tools into the design workflow.
  • Mentors less experienced team members to develop skills while providing feedback they seek and value.

Requirements

  • Minimum three years of experience required in user experience (UX) design, product design, or related field.
  • Bachelors degree preferred
  • Tools: Figma, Mural/Miro, Rally/Jira, Office Suite
  • Deep understanding of UX principles, usability, and product design.
  • Familiarity with customer journey mapping and service blueprinting.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills; able to present ideas clearly and confidently.
  • Effective collaboration and conflict resolution abilities.
  • Excellent time management and project prioritization skills.
  • Experience with agile methodologies and product management practices.
  • Proficiency in design tools like Figma, Mural/Miro, and Microsoft Office.
  • Basic knowledge of front-end development concepts.
  • Strong storytelling and presentation capabilities.

Benefits

This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package:

  1. Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  2. Comprehensive benefits package
  3. Career development and training opportunities
  4. Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  5. Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
  6. Private Health Insurance
  7. Pension Plan
  8. Paid Time Off
  9. Training & Development

title: Senior Manager, Engineering Ops (Devops)
description:
Title : Senior Manager, Engineering Operations

Level : Manager or Senior Manager

Location : Brazil

Work setup : Remote (within 1hr from São Paulo, Brazil) *Eventually will be hybrid, 2-3 days in

office once we open an office next year

Department : Engineering


Talent Systems, LLC is the leading technology solution provider for casting and auditioning to

the entertainment industry. Casting directors and agents worldwide use Talent Systems’

portfolio of products to source and manage talent across film, television, commercials, theater

and digital projects, powering an unparalleled, global casting software ecosystem.

We are headquartered in Los Angeles and operate in the US, Canada, UK, Australia and India.

Our portfolio brands include Casting Networks, Spotlight, Cast It Systems, Cast It Talent,

Casting Frontier, Staff Me Up, Cast It Reach & Tagmin.


Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Head of Engineering, Engineering Operations to lead our

engineering operations which includes areas such DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE),

CI/CD, Release management etc for our cloud-based systems and applications. This role is

pivotal in ensuring the reliability, security, scalability, and availability of our systems while driving

innovation in automation, CI/CD pipelines, and operational efficiency. You will be responsible for

crisis management, improving system performance, cost and fostering a culture of operational

excellence.


Responsibilities

● Leadership and strategy

○ Lead and mentor teams in DevOps, SRE, and Engineering Operations, fostering

a culture of collaboration, ownership, and innovation.○ Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for engineering operations, aligning

with business goals and product requirements.

○ Advocate for and implement industry best practices in system reliability, DevOps,

and automation.

● Reliability and availability

○ Drive initiatives to improve the reliability, availability, and performance of cloud-

based applications and infrastructure.

○ Establish performance measurements for various system health metrics.

○ Ensure robust incident management and crisis response processes to minimize

downtime and customer impact.

● DevOps and CI/CD

○ Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of CI/CD pipelines to

enable seamless and automated deployment processes.

○ Leverage automation tools and practices to reduce manual interventions and

improve operational efficiency.

○ Collaborate with product and engineering teams to enable rapid and reliable

feature delivery.

● Monitoring and observability

○ Implement and maintain advanced monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to

gain deep insights into system health and performance.

○ Use observability tools (e.g., Grafana) to proactively identify and resolve issues

before they impact customers.

● Crisis and Incident Management

○ Lead crisis management efforts during high-severity incidents, ensuring quick

resolution and effective communication with stakeholders.

○ Conduct root cause analyses and drive post-mortem reviews to identify and

address operational gaps.

● Team Development and Collaboration

○ Build, grow, and retain a high-performing engineering operations team with

expertise in DevOps and SRE practices across multiple geolocations.

○ Foster close collaboration with development, data, and product teams to align

engineering operations with overall business objectives.

○ Promote a blameless post-mortem culture to encourage continuous learning and

improvement.

● Cost Optimization and Security

○ Optimize cloud infrastructure costs while maintaining system reliability and

scalability.

○ Implement robust security practices in operations to ensure compliance with

industry standards and regulations.


Qualifications

● 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with 5+ years in leadership roles

● Proven track record of improving system reliability, availability, and performance for

cloud-based applications.

● Extensive experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.

● Demonstrated expertise in crisis management and incident response in high-pressure

environments.

● Deep knowledge of cloud platforms (such as AWS) and container orchestration tools

(Kubernetes, Docker).

● Strong proficiency in monitoring and observability tools like Grafana.

● Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills under pressure.

● Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence

stakeholders across engineering and business teams.

● Proven ability to lead and grow high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.

● A strong focus on fostering a culture of accountability, learning, and operational

excellence.

● Influence partner engineering teams like platform and product engineering.

title: Ad Sales Specialist, Brazil & LATAM
description:
About Whale TV

Whale TV is an independent TV operating system that makes TVs smart and simple to use. Since its inception in 2011, the company has worked with 400+ TV brands and enables 43M+ monthly active TVs around the world to help consumers discover, find and watch their favorite entertainment. With its easy-to-use TV OS, the company connects consumers, TV brands, content providers and advertisers. Whale TV is headquartered in Singapore and has teams collaborating across the globe to make TV better for everyone.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking an Ad Sales Specialist to grow our ad revenue by helping advertisers and demand partners reach consumers in Brazil and LATAM.


Role Overview

As the lead Ad Sales Specialist for the company in Brazil and Latin America, you will be responsible for driving all ad revenue in the region. You will work with Whale TV Ads leadership to define the ad sales strategy for the region, establish strong relationships with the key demand partners and advertisers, establish then meet or exceed revenue goals for Brazil and each country that has a significant Whale TV presence. You will work with colleagues in other Whale TV departments including Ad Ops, Marketing, Content Partnerships, Finance, and others to garner their support in reaching your regional revenue goals.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage relationships with Brazil and LATAM-based agencies, brand advertisers, and trading desks looking to advertise in the region
  • Source ad sales opportunities, create sales proposals and close deals for ad inventory sales
  • Create ad revenue forecasts, goals and targets for ad sales in Brazil and LATAM then regularly report on actuals vs. plan.
  • Work closely with Whale TV’s global inventory, operations, and marketing teams to tailor solutions that match client goals
  • Represent Whale TV at key Brazil and LATAM ad industry events
  • Provide ongoing client support, campaign insights, and upsell opportunities for Brazil and LATAM advertisers and their agencies


Qualifications

  • 3-6 years in digital ad sales or media partnerships, with a focus on Brazil and other LATAM markets
  • Proven track record of hitting revenue targets in advertising sales
  • Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, CTV/OTT, and media selling
  • Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish and English
  • Self-starter with excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Comfortable working independently and across time zones


Why Join Whale TV?

·      Help building the future of global CTV advertising

·      Work with a collaborative international team

·      Access to premium global inventory and innovative ad formats

·      Competitive salary + commission

description:
Role: Operations Manager-Contact Center

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil. Work from office.

Office location: near Santo Amaro Station / Giovani Gronchi. Sao Paulo | Brazil – CENESP

Salary: BRL 10,000/month- BRL 12,000/month


The Operations Manager of a contact center oversees daily operations, manages staff, and ensures high-quality customer service while optimizing efficiency and performance metrics.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee Daily Operations: Manage the overall operations of the contact center, ensuring that all processes run smoothly and efficiently.
  • Staff Management: Supervise, train, and mentor customer service representatives, providing feedback and coaching to improve performance.
  • Performance Monitoring: Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess the effectiveness of operations and implement strategies for improvement.

  • Budget Management: Manage the contact center budget, ensuring that resources are allocated effectively to meet operational needs.
  • Process Improvement: Develop and implement operational procedures to optimize efficiency and productivity within the contact center.
  • Technology Implementation: Drive the adoption of technology solutions to enhance contact center performance and streamline operations.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless customer service experience and address any operational challenges.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Experience: 10-15 years of proven experience as a Contact Center Operations Manager or in a similar role within customer service.
  • Leadership Skills: Strong leadership and interpersonal skills to effectively manage and motivate a team.
  • Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data and trends to make informed decisions and drive performance improvements.
  • Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with contact center technologies and software to manage operations effectively.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities to address issues quickly and efficiently.


Work Environment:

The role typically requires working in an office environment, with the possibility of remote work depending on the organization’s policies. The Operations Manager may need to be available during peak hours to oversee operations and support staff.

  • Infraestrutura de TI: Conhecimentos em LAN, WAN, VPNs, servidores e armazenamento.

title: Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are looking for a Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator who will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of all broadcast and content initiatives within Free Fire Esports. This role combines production, storytelling, and digital strategy expertise to deliver world-class esports broadcasts and high-impact content that enhance the fan experience. The Broadcast & Content Specialist/Coordinator acts as a bridge between internal teams, external vendors, influencers, and regional stakeholders to ensure creative alignment, operational excellence, and consistent brand storytelling across all tournaments and platforms.


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the full broadcast and content pipeline for Free Fire Esports — from pre-production planning to live execution and post-event content delivery.
  • Manage relationships with broadcast vendors, studios, and creative agencies, ensuring adherence to Garena’s quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Supervise on-site production during tournaments, overseeing show flow, run-down execution, and coordination between technical, talent, and content teams.
  • Drive the creative direction of tournament broadcasts, including narrative development, talent integration, segment design, and audience interaction.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Social Media teams to align content distribution plans, ensuring maximum reach and engagement across all digital channels.
  • Oversee the development of post-production deliverables (recaps, highlights, interviews, documentaries, etc.), ensuring consistency in tone, pacing, and storytelling.
  • Analyze viewership and engagement data to inform future broadcast and content strategies, identifying performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Support marketing teams with guidelines and toolkits to ensure global consistency of broadcast quality and messaging.
  • Manage the internal review process for scripts, visual assets, and show rundowns, ensuring narrative cohesion and compliance with brand standards.
  • Stay ahead of emerging broadcast technologies, formats, and fan engagement tools to continuously evolve Free Fire Esports’ viewing experience.



Main job requirements:

  • Education: Completed higher education. Desirable in Communication, Broadcasting, Media Production, or related fields.
  • Experience: 6+ years in esports broadcast production, live event coordination, or content operations.
  • Proven track record leading complex, large-scale broadcast projects with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Strong understanding of esports ecosystems, gaming audiences, and live content dynamics.
  • Experience managing creative and technical production teams (e.g., camera crew, stage talent, editors, motion designers).
  • Solid analytical skills and ability to translate viewership metrics into actionable insights.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and vendor negotiation skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful execution of esports or entertainment broadcasts and digital content initiatives.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP.
  • Preferred: Previous experience with international esports tournaments or live entertainment events. Familiarity with OBS, vMix, or other live production software, and knowledge of streaming infrastructure. Comfortable working under high-pressure live event conditions

title: Crisis Incident Specialist | Incident Safety Operations
description:
We’re Hiring — Crisis Incident Specialist | Incident Safety Operations


Location: Sao Paulo, Sao Paulo

Work Model: On-site with flexibility to respond outside normal business hours when required

Languages: English & Portuguese fluency required


About the Role


We are seeking Crisis Incident Specialists to join our Incident Safety Operations team. You will act as the first line of response for high-risk incidents, ensuring a fast, structured, and accountable reaction in partnership with senior stakeholders.


Key responsibilities:


  • Respond to and manage high-level risk incidents from intake to resolution.
  • Assess severity, trigger the right workflows, and escalate when needed.
  • Coordinate real-time actions with Legal, Safety, PR, and Operations teams.
  • Keep internal teams and external partners accurately informed.
  • Prepare executive-level briefings, reports, and recommendations.
  • Navigate legal, media, and operational risks in fast-moving scenarios.
  • Maintain precise incident logs, status updates, and timelines.
  • Support the Crisis Coordinator during complex events, including War Room operations.
  • Contribute to post-incident reviews and update the Crisis Playbook and templates.


Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Background in tech safety, incident management, risk response, or law enforcement support is a plus.
  • Strong organizational and coordination skills to manage multiple incidents simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — including executive briefings.
  • Ability to stay calm and methodical under pressure.
  • High attention to detail and disciplined documentation.
  • Flexibility to handle urgent incidents outside normal hours.


What We Offer


  • Direct ownership of critical incident response with visible impact on organizational safety and brand protection.
  • Hands-on role with executive exposure and cross-functional crisis management.
  • Growth potential into senior specialist, coordinator, or risk management leadership roles.

Estabelecer metas de relacionamento e vendas para a equipe, acompanhar desempenho via KPIs e OKRs e aplicar planos de desenvolvimento, capacitação e feedback contínuo.

Garantir conformidade com SUSEP, LGPD e políticas internas, zelando por segurança de dados, tratamento adequado de reclamações e atuação preventiva com Ouvidoria.

Produzir e disseminar relatórios executivos da carteira, pipeline de renovações e oportunidades, consolidando insights para a liderança e contribuindo para o planejamento comercial.

Representar a companhia em reuniões com grandes contas, eventos de mercado, reforçando posicionamento e diferenciais competitivos.

Formação superior completa, preferencialmente em Administração, Economia, Ciências Atuariais, Marketing, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;

Pós Graduação será um diferencial;

Vivência nas áreas de Mercado de seguros de Vida e Seguro Viagem, produtos, cobertura, tributação e mecanismos de precificação e tarifação;

description:
About Vammo


Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others.


We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.


About the Role


As Operations Manager, you will be responsible for the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of Vammo’s battery swapping network — the heart of our customer experience. You will oversee 24/7 operations across hundreds of swap stations, leading teams that keep our infrastructure, field logistics, and data systems running at scale. This is not a back-office role: it’s hands-on, mission-critical, and fundamental to shaping how Latin America moves.


Responsibilities


  • Lead and guide our LiveOps, Field Operations, and Infrastructure teams, building a culture of urgency, accountability, and data-driven problem solving.
  • Map, design, and scale operational processes to reduce costs, increase efficiency, and prepare for 10x growth.
  • Be responsible for the network’s uptime, reliability, and incident response, ensuring riders always have batteries available.
  • Define and track core KPIs (uptime, SLAs, maintenance cost, SOC, CSAT) using dashboards and data analysis.
  • Build proactive Customer Experience (CX) processes to communicate downtime and protect our NPS.
  • Serve as the operational voice for Product and Engineering teams, providing real-world feedback for hardware and software design.
  • Guide network expansion decisions (site selection, installation, and launch playbooks).
  • Act as the final escalation point for critical incidents, lead post-mortems, and prevent recurrence.


Requirements


  • +5-8 years experience in managing physical operations, field services, logistics, or technical infrastructure,
  • Strong people leadership; ability to motivate diverse, field-based teams.
  • Data-driven decision-making, with experience using analytics tools (Metabase, Tableau, etc.).
  • Skill in process design, optimization, and creation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Ability to solve problems calmly and decisively under pressure.
  • Pragmatic “owner” mindset (extreme ownership) — equally comfortable in the field and in strategic discussions.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to align technology teams, executives, and field personnel.
  • Technical curiosity — an engineer or operator at heart — with a drive to understand how systems, hardware, and data really work.


Bonus Points if You Have:


  • Experience in high-growth startups.
  • Background in mobility, energy, logistics, IoT, or telecommunications.
  • Experience managing 24/7 mission-critical systems.
  • Familiarity with hardware operations, maintenance cycles, or supply chain management.
  • Basic SQL knowledge for independent analysis.


Benefits


  • Manage a vital area in a fast-growing startup transforming the future of mobility in Latin America, backed by top-tier venture capital investors.
  • Opportunity to work in a mission-driven company — reducing carbon emissions and empowering underserved populations.
  • Be part of a talented, ambitious, and collaborative team that’s building something big.
  • Autonomy and freedom to take on high-impact responsibilities and grow fast.
  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Equity participation — the opportunity to own a piece of the company.
  • Health insurance.

title: Head of FP&A
description:
Sinch is looking for a talented Head of FP&A to join us in Sao Paulo! The Director will serve as a key strategic partner to the Senior Leadership Team in Latin America, leading the overall financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis functions for the organization in Brazil. The Director will report to the VP of FP&A - Americas located in the United States.

This leadership role is responsible for translating business strategy into financial plans, providing data-driven insights to support critical decision-making, and driving operational efficiency and financial performance improvements. The Director will also be responsible for managing, mentoring, and developing a highly performing FP&A team.


Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.


Responsibilities

Financial Analysis and Reporting:

  • Direct the preparation of timely, accurate, and insightful management reports (e.g., Monthly/Quarterly Business Review packages) for the Senior Leadership Team in LatAm
  • Conduct in-depth variance analysis on financial performance (Actuals vs. Budget/Forecast/Prior Year), identifying key trends, opportunities, and risks, and clearly articulating the 'story behind the numbers.'
  • Own and manage the reporting of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring metrics are relevant and drive accountability across the organization.
  • Collaborate with the Accounting and Controllership teams to ensure accurate financial data consolidation and reporting in compliance with local BR GAAP and international standards (e.g., IFRS/US GAAP, if applicable).
  • Prepare compelling financial presentations and reports for executive leadership, and other stakeholders


Strategic Planning, Budgeting, and Forecasting:

  • Lead the comprehensive annual planning (Budget) and long-range planning (LRP) processes for Latin America, primarily in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, ensuring alignment with corporate strategic goals.
  • Manage the quarterly financial forecasting process, incorporating business drivers, market trends, and operational changes to ensure high accuracy and predictability.
  • Develop complex financial models (e.g., scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis) to evaluate new business initiatives, and strategic projects.


Business Partnering and Stakeholder Management:

  • Act as the primary finance partner to the General Manager - LatAm and other functional leaders (Sales, Marketing, Operations), providing financial advice and challenging assumptions.
  • Present financial results, forecasts, and strategic recommendations clearly and persuasively to executive management.
  • Drive continuous improvement in cost management and resource allocation, recommending actions to optimize profitability and operational efficiency.


Team Leadership and Development:

  • Manage, coach, mentor, and motivate a team of FP&A professionals, fostering a culture of high performance, analytical rigor, and professional growth.
  • Define team goals, allocate resources efficiently, and manage workflows to ensure all deliverables are met accurately and on time.
  • Lead efforts to streamline and automate FP&A processes and systems to improve efficiency and data integrity.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. MBA degree highly desirable.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), public accounting, investment banking, or private equity; with a strong focus on operational expenses, and preferably with a large multinational corporation.
  • A minimum of 3+ years of experience managing a team of financial professionals.
  • Experience with financial planning and reporting software (Anaplan, AARO), ERP systems, CRM systems (Salesforce), and Visual Reporting (Tableau) highly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
  • Proven ability to synthesize complex financial data into clear and concise insights for non-financial stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across the organization.

title: Professor
description:
IMK, escola de educação infantil bilíngue localizada no Alto de Pinheiros em São Paulo, procura professora Montessori para sala de 3-6 (Primary)


Responsabilidades:


Gestão do Ambiente Preparado:

  • Preparar e manter meticulosamente um ambiente de aprendizagem Montessori que seja seguro, acessível, organizado, limpo e esteticamente agradável.
  • Garantir que todos os materiais pedagógicos estejam completos, em perfeito estado de conservação e dispostos de forma lógica e atraente.
  • Realizar a rotação de materiais conforme a observação das necessidades e interesses do grupo.
  • Criar uma atmosfera de calma, ordem e respeito mútuo na sala.

Observação e Planejamento Pedagógico:

  • Observar ativamente as crianças em seu trabalho, registrando seu progresso, interesses, desafios e desenvolvimento social, emocional e acadêmico.
  • Utilizar as observações diárias para planejar lições individualizadas e em pequenos grupos, respeitando o ritmo único de cada criança.
  • Manter registros detalhados e precisos do desenvolvimento de cada aluno para acompanhar seu progresso e compartilhar com os pais e a coordenação.

Apresentação de Lições e Orientação (O Papel de "Guia"):

  • Apresentar os materiais e conceitos Montessori (Vida Prática, Sensorial, Linguagem, Matemática e Áreas Culturais) de forma clara, precisa e cativante.
  • Atuar como "Guia", conectando a criança ao material e protegendo seu ciclo de trabalho e concentração, intervindo o mínimo necessário.
  • Estimular a independência, a autodisciplina, a resolução de problemas e o pensamento crítico.
  • Não corrigir o erro da criança diretamente, mas sim guiá-la para que ela mesma o perceba e aprenda com ele.

Desenvolvimento Social e Emocional:

  • Fomentar um ambiente de comunidade e colaboração entre as crianças de idades mistas.
  • Modelar e ensinar ativamente "Graça e Cortesia", orientando as crianças na resolução de conflitos, comunicação respeitosa e habilidades sociais.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento da autoestima, confiança e empatia de cada criança.

Comunicação e Colaboração:

  • Estabelecer e manter uma comunicação regular, transparente e positiva com os pais/responsáveis, compartilhando o progresso da criança e fortalecendo a parceria escola-família.
  • Preparar e conduzir reuniões de pais e conferências individuais.
  • Colaborar ativamente com a assistente de sala, coordenação pedagógica e demais membros da equipe escolar.
  • Participar de reuniões de equipe, eventos escolares e oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional contínuo.


Requisitos e Qualificações

Formação Essencial:

  • Formação Superior: Graduação completa em Pedagogia ou áreas afins (Psicologia, Letras) com a devida complementação pedagógica.
  • Certificação Montessori: Formação (Curso de Especialização) no Método Montessori específica para a faixa etária de 3 a 6 anos (Casa dei Bambini), emitida por uma instituição reconhecida (como AMI, AMS, OMB ou equivalentes).
  • Fluência ou nível avançado em Inglês (para escolas bilíngues).

Experiência Exigida:

  • Experiência prévia comprovada atuando no Método Montessori em um ambiente de 3 a 6 anos.
  • Vivência prática na apresentação de todo o currículo Montessori (Vida Prática, Sensorial, Linguagem, Matemática e Áreas Culturais) para esta faixa etária.

Habilidades e Competências:

  • Profundo Conhecimento: Compreensão sólida da filosofia Montessori e das teorias de desenvolvimento infantil.
  • Capacidade de Observação: Habilidade aguçada para observar a criança de forma científica e neutra, identificando suas necessidades e interesses.
  • Comunicação: Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita, para interagir de forma clara e respeitosa com crianças, pais e colegas de equipe.
  • Inteligência Emocional: Postura calma, paciente, empática e resiliente, sabendo manejar os desafios da sala de aula com equilíbrio.
  • Organização e Planejamento: Forte senso de organização para a manutenção do ambiente e para o planejamento pedagógico individualizado.
  • Proatividade: Capacidade de agir como um(a) facilitador(a) dinâmico(a), em vez de um(a) instrutor(a) diretivo(a).
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Habilidade para colaborar efetivamente com a assistente de sala e demais membros da escola.

Diferenciais (Desejável, mas não obrigatório):

  • Habilidades em artes, música ou movimento.
  • Experiência com crianças com necessidades educacionais especiais (inclusão).
  • Conhecimento em Comunicação Não-Violenta (CNV) ou Disciplina Positiva.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.

Procuramos Cientista de Dados que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D): Conduzir análises exploratórias complexas e desenvolver modelos preditivos e prescritivos para resolver desafios de negócio, desde a otimização de processos até a criação de novos produtos.

Governança de IA e MLOps: Definir, implantar e operacionalizar a governança para todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de Ciência de Dados em ambiente cloud, incluindo a implementação de esteiras de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e versionamento de modelos.

Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Atuar como referência técnica para a equipe, fornecendo suporte a outros cientistas e engenheiros de dados, disseminando conhecimento e garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento.

Arquitetura de Soluções de Dados: Projetar e documentar a arquitetura de soluções de IA configurando ambientes e ferramentas em cloud (preferencialmente Azure) e produzindo templates e aceleradores para otimizar a entrega de projetos.

Colaboração com Stakeholders: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de negócio para entender suas necessidades, traduzir requisitos em especificações técnicas e apresentar os resultados e o valor gerado pelas soluções de forma clara e executiva.

Inovação Contínua: Avaliar e testar novas tecnologias, frameworks e tendências do mercado de IA (ex: Deep Learning, Processamento de Linguagem Natural, Análise de dados de IoT) para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e inovação.

Competências Técnicas :

Linguagens e Ferramentas: Proficiência em Python e/ou R para análise e modelagem de dados.

Machine Learning e Deep Learning: Sólida experiência com bibliotecas como Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch e Keras. Conhecimento prático em técnicas de regressão, classificação, clusterização, séries temporais, Text Analytics (NLP) e visão computacional.

Plataformas de Cloud: Experiência hands-on com serviços de IA em nuvem, especialmente Azure Machine Learning. Conhecimento em Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics e/ou serviços equivalentes em AWS ou GCP é um diferencial.

Bancos de Dados e Big Data: Domínio de estruturas de bancos de dados (Relacional e NoSQL), linguagem SQL e experiência com tecnologias de Big Data como Hadoop, Spark ou MapReduce.

MLOps e Governança: Conhecimento em práticas de DevOps para IA (MLOps), incluindo versionamento de código (Git), CI/CD para modelos e monitoramento da performance em produção. Familiaridade com frameworks de governança corporativa de IA.

Visualização de Dados: Habilidade para criar dashboards e relatórios interativos utilizando ferramentas como Power BI, Tableau ou bibliotecas como Matplotlib e Seaborn.

Certificações (Desejável):

Certificação: Apresentar pelo menos uma certificação relevante em cloud ou dados (ex: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate).

Diferenciais :

Experiência com dados de IoT, especialmente em ambientes industriais ou de manufatura.

Conhecimento em mais de uma plataforma de cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Experiência prévia no setor de atuação da empresa (ex: mineração, finanças, varejo).

Contribuições para a comunidade de tecnologia (ex: projetos open-source no GitHub, artigos em blogs, palestras em eventos).

Inglês avançado/fluente para colaboração com times globais.

Formação:

Formação Acadêmica: Formação superior completa nas áreas mencionadas.

Qualificação Avançada: Pós-graduação, MBA ou Mestrado em Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial ou área afim. Certificações de nível Expert ou Specialty (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty).

O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

title: AI Staff Engineer (Remote)
description:
AI Staff EngineerWe are a collective group of fearless people with a clear purpose: to empower professionals around the world through intelligent workflow automation software. Currently, more than 500 people across 7 countries work with us, remotely or in a hybrid way, to make life easier for over 3,000 companies using Pipefy in more than 180 countries. Since our founding in 2015, we have put people at the center of everything we do, so we invite you to learn more about this position and apply to be part of our team.

You’ll be responsible for empowering users to make the productivity revolution happen in their companies.

As an AI Developer at Pipefy, your mission is to leverage AI to solve user problems proactively! It can be programming a new feature, polishing existing features, supporting a team member, giving feedback, or solving a bug. Your role is crucial in driving our AI capabilities forward.

You'll have the opportunity to conduct and participate in experiments, make suggestions to improve our architecture and product and use tons of data to make the best decisions.

Since we are fully remote, you'll meet and work with people from all around the world.

One paragraph resume about what people can expect from working in this position (Mission in the role, responsibilities, seniority and what profile we are looking for).

Main Responsibilities:

- Develop new features from start to finish: through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance, as well as improve existing ones, focusing on AI-driven functionalities.

- Take responsibility for the system quality by driving testability together with architects and QAs to ensure that the way we design our platform enables controllability and automation.

- Take responsibility for system stability, ensuring proper testing and observability, actively monitoring production behavior, and reacting quickly to incidents.

- Share knowledge with the team and learn together. We believe knowledge is much more valuable when shared, so we’re always learning and teaching each other.

- Take part in the continuous improvement of Engineering processes, like recruiting, hiring, onboarding, documentation, incidents, tech talks, etc.

- Sought out for technical guidance on your squad and related ones, anticipate technical issues at the product level, and make architectural and design decisions to avoid them.

- Consistently reduce the complexity of projects, systems, and processes to get more done with less work. Breaks up deliverables to optimize for earlier feedback and incremental delivery of business value.

- Help the team develop a more robust engineering culture focused on quality and impactful deliveries by setting an example and mentorship.

- Identify and proactively create projects to fix Pipefy's architecture when preconditions change and current architecture is not optimal/fit anymore, extracting and documenting platforms whenever necessary.

Requirements:

- Write correct, clean code with periodic guidance; consistently follows best practices, including tests (unit, functional, integration).

- Exceptional proficiency in Python, LLM applications and AI model integration.

- Design and develop code to provide an integrated and managed development life cycle for traditional and generative ML applications.

- Experience using LLM-based frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph and others.

- Experience in implementing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems and working with vector databases.

- Have practical knowledge about infrastructure, service architectures, tools, libraries, frameworks, continuous integration, and continuous deployment systems.

- Able to seamlessly learn and guide others across large sections of our codebase.

- Actively contributes to the technical design of features.

- Understand and make well-reasoned design tradeoffs in their area.

- Strong ability with RESTful.

Bonus point:

- Experience in fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs.

- Infrastructure: Cloud Computing, AWS, Networks, Load Balancers, Web Servers, Containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, Disaster Recovery, Monitoring.

- Experience with document processing and data extraction pipelines.

- Experience with GraphQL apis.

- You have a sharp eye for UX/UI, and you work user-centered.

- Experience with different types of methodologies and tools for Unit, Integration and End to End testing.

- Have good communication in oral and written English.

- Experience working on agile and lean methodologies.

- Experience building and scaling complex, high-performance, high-transaction applications.

title: Técnico mecânico
description:
A NEUMAN & ESSER impulsiona a transição energética e a economia circular com confiabilidade e soluções integradas para a infraestrutura de energia do futuro. Nossas soluções em compressão, com tecnologia própria de vedação, são usadas no processamento industrial de gases, tanto na indústria tradicional de petróleo e gás, como na economia do hidrogênio verde. O portfólio de produtos também inclui sistemas de produção de hidrogênio sustentável, como eletrolisadores e reformadores, as principais tecnologias para a demanda futura por energia limpa.

Com mais de um século de experiência na compressão de hidrogênio, a NEUMAN & ESSER é hoje a especialista em toda a cadeia de valor de H2. Quando se trata de dar vida a projetos ambiciosos, a NEUMAN & ESSER é o seu parceiro - desde a avaliação de potenciais plantas, viabilidade e financiamento do projeto, passando pela engenharia, construção e comissionamento, até à comercialização dos gases produzidos. Nossas soluções em engenharia de processos mecânicos apresentam diferenciais expressivos para a moagem e classificação de matérias-primas e materiais reciclados. Os nossos sistemas demonstram uma contribuição essencial em aplicações como tinta em pó e enriquecimento protéico, bem como na produção de materiais de alta performance para sistemas de armazenamento de energia em baterias.

A confiabilidade e a disponibilidade são a base de parcerias de longo prazo e são garantidas em nossas plantas com um serviço digital 360° durante a operação. A continuidade de uma empresa familiar com quase 200 anos e a nossa rede global de fabricação, vendas e serviços, garantem a proximidade junto aos nossos clientes. Seja em projetos envolvendo máquinas novas, seja na área de serviços, peças OEM ou qualquer atividade de pós-vendas, estamos perto do nosso cliente. Orientados a soluções ágeis, criativas e inovadoras, desenvolvemos o conhecimento dos nossos mais de 1.700 colaboradores para atender as necessidades do mercado.

Operar os produtos da empresa significa ser responsável pelos processos operacionais e financeiros derivados de cada produto, o que inclui realizar rotinas internas de backoffice e trabalhar em conjunto com parceiros externos (exchanges, bancos, fornecedores de tecnologia, etc.).

Para isso, esperamos de você:

  • Superior completo.
  • Experiência no mercado financeiro.
  • Experiência com linguagens de programação para análise de dados, com prática nas principais bibliotecas, como Python (pandas, sklearn, numpy, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn) e R (ggplot2, dplyr, tidyverse, purrr).
  • Excel avançado.
  • Conhecimento em Crypto ou Câmbio.
  • Experiência na criação de dashboards (Power BI).

Conheça o pacote de benefícios que temos preparado para você:
